data.title: Erasmus+ exchange: submit Learning Agreement
data.summary: The International Office of the University of Beispielstadt congratulates you on your Erasmus+ nomination for winter 2026/27 at the University of Musterholm. You must submit the signed Learning Agreement by 15 May 2026.
data.explanation: You have been nominated for an Erasmus+ exchange semester. To pass your application on to the host university, the International Office needs your signed Learning Agreement, uploaded through the Mobility-Online portal by 15 May 2026. Without it, the application cannot be forwarded. Contact the International Office if you have questions about the form.
